source.title: feat(config): add task variables for the context window (#4234)

criteria: `DEVOPS_CLI_AI_TASK_STAGE_CONTEXT_WINDOW=131072 uv run python -c "from devops_cli.config.settings import load_settings; assert load_settings().ai.for_task('stage').context_window == 131072"` passes. It fails today: the value is 262144.
The same check passes for `analysis` and `verification`, and for `MAX_TOKENS`. It fails today.
`uv run pytest tests/config/test_ai_task_settings_paths.py -k context_window` passes. The test sets each variable and reads `for_task(task)`. It fails today: the test does not exist.
`git grep -n "AI_TASK_STAGE_CONTEXT_WINDOW" -- docs/ENV_VARS.md` finds the variable. It fails today.
`uv run devops docs generate` leaves no diff in `docs/ENV_VARS.md`, and `uv run pytest tests/test_config_declarations.py` passes with the new variables in its set.
